row.evidence: Teradata's Elastic Compute guide says SCIM keeps users and group memberships in sync with the IdP ('When you remove the user, Teradata revokes access'), while the pricing page only offers Fixed + Flex packages via a pricing specialist.
row.notes: Quote-only: teradata.com/pricing describes Fixed + Flex pricing in Teradata Units with three unnamed packages and no public prices ('Talk to a Teradata pricing specialist'), so SCIM can only be bought through sales. New row. SCIM (Global Identity) is documented for Teradata Cloud Elastic Compute (released June 2026) and is not available for the existing Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) or Active Compute. Each site gets its own generated SCIM endpoint, client ID/secret and a bearer token that expires in at most 90 days. Okta and Entra are configured with generic SCIM apps (Okta 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth)', Entra non-gallery app); Ping Identity is also named. SSO is OIDC only (SAML not supported) and is mandatory for Elastic Compute. Okta's catalogue lists only 'Teradata Marketing Studio', a different product. No REST user-management API for the console is documented.

plans.name: Fixed + Flex packages (three, unnamed)
plans.notes: Pricing page names 'Three packages' but no package names or prices; SSO/SCIM apply to Teradata Cloud Elastic Compute sites, package mapping not stated.

auth.token_source: Admin Console > Access control > Provisioning users > Enable (SCIM URL, client ID/secret, then Generate access token)

operations.notes: Okta setup enables Create Users, Update User Attributes and Deactivate Users; PUT vs PATCH not documented.

attributes.notes: Only userName is documented (becomes the Teradata database username; defaults to email in Okta and Entra).

roles.how: IdP groups synced by SCIM are mapped to platform roles in Admin Console (Access Control > Role mapping) and to Elastic Compute roles (Site Admin, Data Curator, Data User, custom roles synced through SCIM).

limitations.text: SCIM applies only to Elastic Compute, not to the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) or Active Compute.
Bearer token expires in at most 90 days and must be rotated; client secret and token are shown only once.
SSO is OIDC only; SAML is not supported.
Sync typically takes 5 to 40 minutes, depending on the IdP.
Each site has its own SCIM endpoint and credentials; they cannot be reused across sites.

scim.notes: Endpoint URL is generated per site in Admin Console (Access control > Provisioning users) and shown only once; its pattern is not published. Version 2.0 is inferred from the Okta 'SCIM 2.0 Test App' template the docs use. A parallel set of pages covers the same steps in 'Vantage Console'.

user_api.notes: No REST user-management API for Teradata Cloud Admin Console was found in docs.teradata.com search. Database users are managed with SQL (CREATE/DROP/MODIFY USER), which SCIM itself uses for EDW via a SCIM admin database account.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'teradata' returns only Teradata Marketing Studio (a different product). Teradata's docs use Okta's generic 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth)'.

entra.notes: Teradata's docs use an Entra non-gallery app ('Integrate any other application'); no gallery tutorial found.

google.notes: Not mentioned by Teradata; not checked.

onelogin.notes: Not mentioned by Teradata; connector pages block bots.

jumpcloud.notes: Not mentioned by Teradata; not checked.

fallbacks.notes: SCIM must provision a user before SSO sign-in works, so there is no JIT on sign-in for Elastic Compute.

citations.quote: When you add a user to the correct group in the IdP, Teradata automatically creates the account with the correct role. When you remove the user, Teradata revokes access.

citations.title: Stage 3: Automate User Provisioning with SCIM
citations.quote: SCIM handles the user lifecycle, and the IdP handles authentication. SCIM must provision a user before the user can sign in using SSO.

citations.title: SCIM Terms
citations.quote: The unique HTTPS URL that the IdP uses to send provisioning requests. The Console generates this URL per site. You cannot reuse a URL across sites.

citations.title: SCIM Terms
citations.quote: Included in the Authorization header of every SCIM request. The token expiry can be up to 90 days. Token expiry is the most common cause of SCIM failure, so plan token rotation.

citations.title: SCIM Terms
citations.quote: The SCIM value that becomes the Teradata database username. This value must match the username claim from sign-in. It defaults to email in both Okta and Entra.

citations.title: Enable SCIM in Admin Console
citations.quote: In the Access token expiration section, set the access token expiration (up to 90 days).

citations.title: Enable SCIM in Admin Console
citations.quote: You cannot retrieve the Client Secret and Access Token afterward. You can only rotate them, and rotating the secret requires the original value.
